chapter: Left out of the jazz books; Tatum, Handy and family
title: Rudy Blesh's claim about Lester Young and Billie Holiday
summary: Collins doubts Blesh's claim Prez ate at Billie's mother's place, saying he was eating with Harold West.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Yeah, yeah. Yeah. Well, no, Lester didn't go with Billie, you know. No, no. Billie and I were a little tight at one time, but, you know, nothing serious, you know. But I don't think Prez went with Billie at all. No. Rudy Blesh
According to Rudy Blesh they did.
Well, that figures, you know, that figures, you know. You consider the source. See, you know how I feel now. He didn't even mention me, so you know how factual he is about --
Well, you mean when Lester was really
eating at the Woodside when Rudi Blesh
(inaudible) Rudy Blush said he was (inaudible), eating at Billie's place with her mother.
He was eating with Harold West.
Yes. But that's just amazing. You know, I just don't understand it, but okay.
